shows.title: Electra/Persona
shows.description: See Cate Blanchett and Nina Hoss star in *Electra/Persona*, Benedict Andrews’s new National Theatre production bringing Sophocles’ ancient tragedy together with Ingmar Bergman’s psychological drama.

shows.title: As You Like It - Globe
shows.description: Run wild and free in the muddy magic of the woods this summer with this euphoric new production of Shakespeare’s As You Like It in the Globe Theatre.

shows.title: Flamenc Oh!!
shows.description: World-class flamenco with a wild twist, this brand-new dance comedy sees physical theatre collide with the passion and power of flamenco.
